description: Declarative mapping of org-level policy files to per-repo targets. The sync workflow applies the named template to each listed repo (creating or overwriting the file) and opens a drift PR when the content differs. A repo in the 'skip' set for a file is never touched, preserving legitimate bespoke content. LICENSE defaults to Apache-2.0 for every repo not listed in overrides or skip; SECURITY.md is opt-in per template.
